See where Earth is warming, wetting, drying, or shifting — and whether those trends look statistically meaningful.

Explore the atlas How it works

How to use

  1. Choose a layerTemperature, rainfall, ice, wind, and more.
  2. Pick a placeSearch a city or click the map.
  3. Watch time moveScrub years or open the 30-year trend.
  4. Read the signalAnomaly, rate of change, and significance.

Colors show anomalies — difference from a place’s usual baseline, not absolute temperature. City names jump to the nearest ~2° grid cell. “Significant at 5%” is a local test, not proof of a cause.
